title: Peer Protocol
key_points: The peer protocol is used by XRP Ledger to communicate between peers.
Peers in the XRP Ledger network exchange transaction information, validators and other network data using this protocol.
The protocol supports a variety of communication methods including HTTP, WebSocket, and TCP.
limitations: Does not cover all technical details and specifications of the peer protocol
Focuses on general concepts rather than specific implementation or use cases
asserts: The XRP Ledger network uses the peer protocol to exchange transaction information, validators, and other network data between peers via methods like HTTP, WebSocket, and TCP.
scope: Explains how the peer protocol enables communication of transaction info, validators, and other network metadata in the XRP Ledger system.
